title: Milestone 1.5: the rest of machine, settings and DOS audio
summary: The start-up check screen before play, the HUD's toast line and level-name banner, and a first listen to DOS audio on real hardware.

title: Milestone 2: fizz-bake and the pack loaders
summary: `fizz-bake`, reading `script fizz2 0`, then the pack loaders on both platforms, the audio and sprite sections and the floppy image tools. The format, its reader, the OPX spec and the level source refactor are in chapter 11; `LEVL` version 2, the rules, the script dialect and `fizz-script` are in chapter 15.

title: Milestone 3: scene intent and the camera
summary: fizz-engine, the scene contract and a camera with Fizz 1's pixel-locking, on Web and DOS, with more of the level shown on a large screen. The parallax layers, the whitewashed wall and Ben's stop at a wall are in chapter 12, the Night setting and the lights in chapter 14.

title: Milestone 3.5: the rest of the mechanics roster
summary: Ladders and vines (specified in `docs/CLIMBING.md`, not built), mantle, lifts, switches and the enemy AI set. The wall-kick, its first mechanic, is in chapter 15.

title: Milestone 4.5: song sources and OPL tools
summary: Separately authored songs, stereo-authored effects, the FM-to-OPL downmix, Fizz 1 DOS's data for the other eight effects, the OPL3 core-and-extras and music compression ideas, OPX adoption and an audit of redundant register writes. Milestone 4, the effects and captions, is in chapters 9 and 10.

title: Milestone 5: CI gates and the 486 budget
summary: A cycle budget gated in CI on the 486 estimate, and size budgets. The estimator and the measured case against a changed-span copy are in chapter 13.

title: Milestone 6: shell
summary: Title, pause, options, four save slots, result cards and the opening cinematic. A placeholder with no start date.
